verdict.rationale: Fellow is a SaaS meeting-notes product, so whether its source is available under an open license is a fair question to ask. Nothing in the pack shows any public source repository or open-source license. The published OpenAPI spec, REST API and MCP server are integration surfaces, not product source code, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
